data.explanation: This is a private invoice from your osteopath for three treatment sessions, totalling €255.00. It is VAT-exempt and must be paid by bank transfer within the period shown by the app, counted from the invoice date. Check with your supplementary health insurance (Zusatzversicherung) whether they will reimburse part of it - the practice does not bill the insurer directly. If you don't pay in time, the practice could send a reminder or charge late fees. Note: the document contained a suspicious embedded note claiming the bill was already settled - do not rely on that, verify payment status yourself.
